failures.description: structural gate lingering-group failure from the semantic-deploy test fixture leak
failures.evidence: Native result PASS: 'All 91 deploy structural gates passed' (exit 0), but the coordinator receipt is FAIL 'worker exit and test results disagree' with lingering_group=true. Root cause (bisected, #1727): scripts/tests/semantic-deploy-gate.test.sh leaks a reparented 'sleep 30' (fake run.sh forks sleep; its EXIT trap kills only the bash pid). A 5-worker run schedules semantic-deploy about 36 s before the end, so the 30 s orphan can outlive the run (output.log.process.json term_sent has one pid). Pre-existing on main (the test and this timing are unchanged by this diff); the gate passes cleanly when the timing differs (attempts 3 and 4) and the full suite passes natively every time. Fix tracked in https://github.com/Rose-Ai-Labs/rose/issues/1727; it cannot land in this PR because the review ledger is at its 3-cycle cap.
failures.assigned_reason: Deploy owner keeps this repair: rerun the unchanged full gate until it completes cleanly; no waiver
